query: What action should motorists take when they notice buses pulling out of the bus bay?
reference_answer: Motorists should slow down and watch out for buses pulling out of the bus bay.
context:
[Document 1]
Motorists should slow down and watch out for buses pulling out of the bus bay.

[Document 2]
It indicates a mandatory give-way to buses area.

[Document 3]
Drivers should proceed to complete their turn and clear the junction.

[Document 4]
The red paint alerts motorists to the presence of merging vehicles from bus-stops.

[Document 5]
Slow down, keep left, and beware of oncoming traffic.
answer: Motorists should slow down and watch out for buses pulling out of the bus bay. [Document 1] and [Document 4] indicate this.
